summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Federated Hermes International Leaders ETF (FHIL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund primarily focuses on non-US value companies from developed markets by employing fundamental company analysis and valuation disciplines. The actively managed ETF still reserves the flexibility to invest in companies from the US and emerging market countries. FHIL was launched on Jun 17, 2026 and is issued by Federated Hermes.

holdings.infoBox: FHIL is an equity ETF with a total of 78 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 3.22%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 3.19%, AstraZeneca at 2.50%, Sony Group at 2.50%, and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group at 2.43%.
